description.value: Tozen Sushi Bar is a contemporary Japanese restaurant on West Broadway in Vancouver, helmed by Chef Tom with over ten years of experience refining traditional Japanese technique. The menu spans classic nigiri and sashimi to creative sharing plates, with premium bluefin tuna as a centrepiece offering. Cyclists will find a full sit-down dining experience with takeout also available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM address (967 W Broadway, Vancouver); phone and email are present on the website but absent from OSM tags. The menu page explicitly lists Vegetarian, Vegan, and Gluten Free filter categories, and the contact subpage title ('Contact Us for Reservations or Take-Out') confirms takeout is offered. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; 604 416 4949 sourced from website only and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
Website hours contain an internal contradiction: 'Monday - Thursday 12:00 - 9:30 PM' but also 'Tuesday Closed' — actual operating days are ambiguous and may indicate outdated website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Tozen Sushi Bar is a legitimate, active restaurant well-suited to touring cyclists for a meal stop, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) are confirmed from available evidence; on-site verification is needed before listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page includes dedicated filter tabs labelled Vegetarian, Vegan, and Gluten Free with items listed under each
